milestones.description: AJ20P4 (2.0L Petrol PHEV), ~404 PS combined, introduced in the L405 Range Rover facelift, featuring an 8-speed automatic transmission and an integrated electric motor with a 13.1 kWh battery.

Continued in the all-new L460 Range Rover generation, featuring an upgraded battery capacity (up to 31.8 kWh) and refined Ingenium petrol architecture for extended electric-only range and improved efficiency.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover P400e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover P400e (AJ20P4) combines complex hybrid architecture with the 2.0L Ingenium petrol engine. While generally refined, it shares known weaknesses with the broader Ingenium petrol family. Rebuilt engines sourced through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Water Pump & Cooling System Failure - Why the Range Rover P400e AJ20P4 Suffers Thermal Stress
problems.rootCause: Plastic water pump impellers and thermostat housings can degrade over time, leading to coolant loss, overheating warnings, and potential cylinder head damage if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the water pump, thermostat, and flushing the cooling system with OEM-spec coolant.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable preventative fix if caught before severe overheating occurs.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if overheating has warped the cylinder head or caused catastrophic internal damage.

problems.recommendation: For minor cooling leaks or early timing chain noise, targeted specialist repair is highly cost-effective. However, if the AJ20P4 has suffered catastrophic overheating, severe head warping, or timing chain jump, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded internals offers the best long-term reliability and protects your significant vehicle investment.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Why the Range Rover P400e AJ20P4 Develops Cold-Start Rattles
problems.rootCause: Early Ingenium petrol timing chain tensioners can wear, allowing the chain to stretch and rattle on cold starts, with a risk of jumping teeth if left unaddressed.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Installing an updated OEM-spec timing chain kit with a revised, more robust tensioner.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended preventative measure for units approaching 60k miles.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if the chain has already jumped or secondary valve/piston damage has occurred.
